what: A hand-drawn board 1.25x larger than its cell slides straight opposite to the mouse — by the ratio the mouse is off the cell center (−1 to 1) times the half width and half height the board overflows the cell (for a 1440 cell and 2326px board, ±733px left and right). Leaving the cell returns it to place. Hovering a character on the board lifts it 1.12x · 10px and tilts it (.4s bouncy curve), and the finger lifts only the pressed character for .45s
ease: none (straight to the mouse) · character cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)
note: Scale is the css variable --fx-scale (default 1.25), character tilt is --fx-tilt (default 3deg). Panel size is set by whoever uses it — the wider than the cell, the more it shifts
use: …
